status: Source-level falsification test, not cluster evaluation
hypotheses: A shared successful connection timestamp cannot identify the realization time of each overlapping allow policy.
An unqualified policy-name timestamp map can mix same-named policies in different namespaces.
method: Extract and execute the unmodified result-aggregation loop from pinned Kube-burner source in a small Go fixture. Supply deterministic synthetic timestamps and compare against independently stated fixture facts.
controls: Overlap with all creation times preceding connection success
Overlap with one later creation time
Two different policy realization histories with identical observable input
rejection: Reject the mechanism if source aggregation preserves unique namespace identity or independently observes each policy realization. Even a reproduced discrepancy does not establish field-wide novelty.
interpretation: Effective connectivity and individual policy realization are different estimands. If the intended metric is effective connectivity, overlap alone is not a defect. No claim of unauthorized network access follows.
literature_basis: Kube-burner pinned source and published measurement definition
next_gate: Native end-to-end reproduction and closest-work review required before a publication-level contribution claim.
